stories.title: Al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb bombs government targets in Algiers

stories.title: Umaru Yar'Adua wins a flawed Nigerian election
stories.summary: It was the first civilian-to-civilian handover; his illness later elevated Goodluck Jonathan.

stories.title: Cyberattacks hit Estonia after a Soviet war memorial is moved
stories.summary: The attacks on Estonian sites were blamed on Russian actors and led NATO to set up its cyber centre in Tallinn.

stories.title: Chávez takes control of the Orinoco heavy-oil projects
stories.summary: Foreign oil majors had to cede majority stakes to PDVSA; ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips left.

stories.era: 2007 (Iraq surge, Putin's Munich speech, the credit crunch begins)
stories.title: Nicolas Sarkozy is elected president of France
stories.summary: He went on to lead the 2011 Libya intervention.

stories.title: Hamas seizes control of Gaza from Fatah
stories.summary: The split left Palestinians divided between Gaza and the West Bank; Israel and Egypt tightened a blockade.

stories.title: Tony Blair steps down and Gordon Brown becomes British prime minister
